Adding sizing detail from infra-capacity side. If you want conservative run-rate estimates, I need these minimal inputs per-deal (send as one-line bullets):
- expected P50 QPS, expected P95 QPS (or sessions/minute)
- average sequence length (tokens) and 95th percentile
- concurrency target (max concurrent users) for pilot vs committed
- target model variant (raven-3, raven-3-quant, or smaller family)

Based on the ACME description in the snapshot, initial quick size (conservative):
- Acme pilot (assume P95 QPS = 12, avg seq = 160 tokens, concurrency target = 60): ~4 A100-equiv GPUs for pilot (sustained), plan 8 GPUs for committed posture.
- Nova AI POC (bursty): plan a 2-GPU reserved pool + autoscale top-up for bursts.

Notes: these are ballpark until we have real telemetry. If ACME uses raven-3 with sequence lengths >256 we should prefer H100-class for latency SLOs. Also call out if customer requires KV-cache persistence (adds memory pressure).
